name: Shoulder girdle motion
about: How far the glenohumeral (GH) joint centre moves when the arm is raised, because the clavicle and scapula move with it. Tables are millimetres against arm elevation in degrees; 'forward' is scaled by the plane factor below.

rhythm.about: Scapular upward rotation = max(0, elevation - onset) x slope: 60 of 180 degrees at full raise (Inman 1944's 2:1 rhythm).

source: Shape after Inman 1944 and Ludewig 2009 (clavicle elevation and retraction during arm elevation); exoskeleton studies report the GH centre moving several centimetres over a full raise. Approximate, editable.
